title: Skyrimnet Prompts - Cache Enabled
description:
This set of prompts are structured to utilize cached input, thereby reducing increasing speed and reducing costs. In tests, this was able to reduce the cost of some models by more than 56% with no observable drop in quality. When using this build, I would suggest significantly increasing the size of your number of events in the history, as this is far cheaper with this change.

Requires Beta27-rc4 or newer (Alpha tester only at the time of posting this).
